metadata.guidance: Only modify or replace the following rule(s): Hyphenated_Ampersand_Corporate_Name. Do NOT create new rules or touch any other rules.

messages.content:
{
  "analysis": "The primary failures stem from the 'Generic_KG_Entity' and 'Hyphenated_Ampersand_Corporate_Name' rules matching only the suffix (e.g., 'GmbH & Co KG') instead of the full company name, and missing specific court names like 'Bezirksgericht Neunkirchen' and 'Bezirksgericht Hall (in Tirol)'. The 'Domain_Organisation' rule is too greedy, matching only the TLD. The 'Hyphenated_Ampersand_Corporate_Name' rule also needs to explicitly handle 'GesmbH' as requested in user feedback.",
  "strategy": "Replace the overly broad 'Generic_KG_Entity' and 'Hyphenated_Ampersand_Corporate_Name' rules with a single, prioritized rule that captures the full corporate name including 'GesmbH & Co KG' and 'GmbH & Co KG' patterns, while adding specific rules for missing court names and tightening the domain rule.",
  "note": "Every rule must include both output_template and output_key. The 'Hyphenated_Ampersand_Corporate_Name' rule is being replaced to fix the 'GesmbH' feedback and the partial match issue.",
  "rules": [
    {
      "name": "Hyphenated_Ampersand_Corporate_Name",
      "description": "Matches corporate names with hyphens, plus signs, or ampersands, including 'GmbH & Co KG', 'GesmbH & Co KG', and 'AG' suffixes. Captures the full name.",
      "format": "regex",
      "priority": 7,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "content": "(?<![\\w])([A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)*|[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:-[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)+|[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\+[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)+|[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\s+und\\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)+|[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\s*&\\s*[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)+)\\s+(?:GesmbH\\s*&\\s*Co\\s*KG|GmbH\\s*&\\s*Co\\s*KG|GesmbH|GmbH|AG|Aktiengesellschaft|Gesellschaft\\s+mbH)\\b"
    },
    {
      "name": "Generic_KG_Entity",
      "description": "Matches generic corporate entities ending in KG (Kommanditgesellschaft) which were previously missing, capturing the full name.",
      "format": "regex",
      "priority": 6,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "content": "(?<![\\w])([A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)*|[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:-[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)+|[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\+[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)+|[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\s+und\\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)+|[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\s*&\\s*[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)+)\\s+KG\\b"
    },
    {
      "name": "Domain_Organisation",
      "description": "Matches organization names ending in .at (e.g., 'Logderfurt-Logistik.at', 'YNKW Elektro.at').",
      "format": "regex",
      "priority": 4,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "content": "\\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:[-+&][A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)*\\.at\\b"
    },
    {
      "name": "Bezirksgericht_City_Extended",
      "description": "Matches District Courts with city names, including specific missing cities like Ried im Innkreis, Mödling, Floridsdorf, Neunkirchen, and districts.",
      "format": "regex",
      "priority": 8,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "content": "\\bBezirksgerichts?\\s+(?:Melk|Steyr|Feldbach|Rohrbach|Enns|Donaustadt|Fünfthau|Innere\\s+Stadt\\s+Wien|Schwechat|Liesing|Gmunden|Bad\\s+Ischl|Wels|Telfs|Neusiedl\\s+am\\s+See|Favoriten|Josefstadt|Hietzing|Graz-West|Graz-Ost|Kirchdorf\\s+an\\s+der\\s+Krems|Amstetten|Vöcklabruck|Döbling|St\\.\\s+Pöltten|Kufstein|Laa\\s+an\\s+der\\s+Thaya|Schwaz|Hall|Dornbirn|Bludenz|Lustenau|Hohenems|Rankweil|Schaan|Vaduz|Balzers|Triesen|Triesenberg|Eschen|Mauren|Gamprin|Planken|Schellenberg|Au|Ruggell|Bregenz|Feldkirch|Leoben|Lienz|Villach|Wels|Salzburg|Innsbruck|Eisenstadt|Klagenfurt|Graz|Wien|Linz|Bregenz|Feldkirch|Leoben|Lienz|Villach|Wels|St\\.\\s+Pöltten|Schwaz|Hall|Innsbruck|Dornbirn|Bludenz|Feldkirch|Bregenz|Lustenau|Dornbirn|Hohenems|Rankweil|Schaan|Vaduz|Balzers|Triesen|Triesenberg|Eschen|Mauren|Gamprin|Planken|Schellenberg|Au|Ruggell|Ried\\s+im\\s+Innkreis|Mödling|Floridsdorf|Fürstenfeld|Grieskirchen|Neulengbach|Deutschlandsberg|Hermagor|Freistadt|Neunkirchen)\\b"
    },
    {
      "name": "Bezirksgericht_Hall_Tirol",
      "description": "Matches 'Bezirksgericht Hall (in Tirol)' specifically to handle the missing case with parenthetical context.",
      "format": "regex",
      "priority": 8,
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "content": "\\bBezirksgerichts?\\s+Hall\\s+\\(in\\s+Tirol\\)\\b"
    }
  ],
  "deleted_rules": [
    "Generic_KG_Entity",
    "Hyphenated_Ampersand_Corporate_Name"
  ]
}
